use_predicted_trajectory.description: Flag to use the predicted path from the control module.

use_imu_path.description: Flag to use the predicted path generated by sensor data.

limit_imu_path_lat_dev.description: Flag to limit the lateral deviation of the IMU path.

limit_imu_path_length.description: Flag to limit the length of the IMU path.

use_pointcloud_data.description: Flag to use the obstacle grid for collision detection.

use_predicted_object_data.description: Flag to use predicted object data.

use_object_velocity_calculation.description: Flag to use object velocity calculation. If false, object velocity is set to 0 m/s.

check_autoware_state.description: Flag to enable or disable Autoware state check.

imu_path_lat_dev_threshold.description: Lateral deviation threshold for the IMU path.

min_generated_imu_path_length.description: Minimum distance for a predicted path generated by sensors.

max_generated_imu_path_length.description: Maximum distance for a predicted path generated by sensors.

kinematic_state_timeout_sec.description: Staleness watchdog for the kinematic_state yaw source [s]; a twist older than this makes the imu-path yaw source unavailable (fail-safe: the imu path is skipped that cycle), never treated as a usable or zero-yaw estimate.

imu_prediction_time_horizon.description: Time horizon of the predicted path generated by sensors.

imu_prediction_time_interval.description: Time interval of the predicted path generated by sensors.

mpc_prediction_time_horizon.description: Time horizon of the predicted path generated by MPC.

mpc_prediction_time_interval.description: Time interval of the predicted path generated by MPC.

detection_range_max_height_margin.description: Margin added to the vehicle height for the per-cell upper z-band gate.

expand_width.description: Expansion width of the ego vehicle for collision checking and speed calculation.

speed_calculation_expansion_margin.description: Expansion width of the ego vehicle footprint used for speed calculation.

cluster_minimum_height.description: Per-cell low_max_height floor [m]; a grid cell qualifies only if its tallest in-band return (low_max_height) is at least this value.

minimum_cluster_size.description: Minimum summed point_count over an 8-connected component of qualifying cells. Counts RAW returns (the grid is pre-voxel), so values tuned for the old post-voxel cluster size may need to be raised.

min_point_count_cell.description: Per-cell density floor [returns]; a cell qualifies only if its point_count is at least this value.

obstacle_grid_timeout_sec.description: Staleness watchdog for the obstacle grid [s]; a grid older than this is treated as unavailable (fail-safe), never as clear.

longitudinal_offset_margin.description: Longitudinal offset distance for collision checking.

t_response.description: Response time for the ego vehicle to detect a decelerating object.

a_ego_min.description: Maximum deceleration value of the ego vehicle.

collision_keeping_sec.description: Time duration to keep detecting a collision.

previous_obstacle_keep_time.description: Time duration to keep the previous obstacle detected.

aeb_hz.description: Frequency at which the AEB module operates.
